## 👋 Thanks for your contribution to ProfeAI!

Please follow the checklist so we can review your PR quickly.

## 📝 Description

Explain what you changed and why.

## 🔗 Related Issue

Closes #<issue-number> (if applicable)

## 🎯 Type of Change

- [ ] `fix` – Bug fix
- [ ] `feat` – New feature
- [ ] `docs` – Documentation
- [ ] `content` – New exercise / prompt / dataset entry
- [ ] `style` – UI/style only
- [ ] `chore` – Tooling / CI

## ✅ Pre-Submission Checklist

- [ ] I have run the app or tests relevant to my change.
- [ ] I followed the project’s coding style.
- [ ] I updated docs or comments where needed.
- [ ] This PR targets the `main` branch.

If you’re not sure about any step, submit anyway and ask in the comments — we’re happy to help!
